# Repository About description

2.4 PRE-BETA open-source DJ application written in Rust for Windows and Linux. A simple alternative to VirtualDJ, Serato DJ and rekordbox, with 2/4 decks, effects, MIDI, hot cues and a music library. Original application code; openly licensed libraries and artwork. AGPL-3.0-or-later.

GitHub returned HTTP 403 (Resource not accessible by integration) when attempting to update the About metadata. Paste the description above into the repository About field using GitHub settings.
